title: Order Tax Calculation Fix
changes: Fixed order tax calculation inconsistency between POS and manual edits.
Implemented exclusive tax logic (VAT added on top) in order edit page and controller.
Corrected database storage to ensure subtotal reflects net amount (exclusive of tax).
Fixed invoice display issue where tax was doubled on manual order updates.

title: Featured Product Curation & Homepage Redesign
changes: Implemented AJAX-powered 'Featured' product toggle in Admin Inventory for manual curation.
Complete Homepage Redesign with dedicated sections for 'Featured Products' and 'Latest Arrivals'.
Added Google Merchant (Auto Product Integration) with dynamic XML feed synchronization.
Integrated Facebook Pixel and Google Ads Pixel for advanced conversion tracking.
Added TikTok Pixel integration for expanded social media marketing reach.
Enhanced shop responsiveness and button hover animations for a premium user experience.
Standardized branding with emerald color #2DAE9A for arrivals and core UI accents.

title: Solution SEO Meta Enhancements
changes: Added SEO Meta fields (Title, Description, Keywords) to Solutions.
Updated Admin Solution creation and editing interfaces to support SEO fields.
Integrated Dynamic SEO Meta tags into Frontend Solution pages.

title: Category SEO Enhancements
changes: Added SEO Meta fields (Title, Description, Keywords) to Categories.
Updated Admin Category creation and editing interfaces to support SEO fields.
Integrated Dynamic SEO Meta tags into Frontend Shop pages.

title: Security Hardening
changes: Implemented Rate Limiting for Customer Login to prevent brute force attacks.
Conducted comprehensive security audit of SQL queries and file uploads.

title: Dynamic SEO & Professional Versioning
changes: Implemented Dynamic SEO Mirror Pages for Categories and Products.
Added Footer Visibility Control for all custom pages.
Integrated Select2 for searchable category/product selection in admin.
Added professional Versioning and Change Log system.
Resolved route name collisions for better stability.

title: Core Optimization
changes: Bug fixes and security updates in authentication flow.
Optimized database queries for product listing pages.
Improved mobile responsiveness of the admin dashboard.

title: Initial Refinements
changes: Fixed layout issues in order details page.
Added VAT calculations to the checkout process.

Core modules: POS, Inventory, Sales, CRM, and Settings.
